sidebar.noTasks: No tasks yet. Start one and its desktop appears here.
sidebar.dragHint: Drag a task onto the screens to open it beside the others.

empty.title: Nothing open
empty.body: Choose a task on the left, or start a new one. Drag a second task here to watch them side by side, up to four.

drop.add: Drop to open this task beside the others
drop.replace: Drop on a screen to put this task there
drop.full: Four screens are open. Drop on one to replace it.

task.deleteBody: Its desktop, everything on it and the conversation are deleted. This cannot be undone.
task.missing: This task is not here any more. It may have been deleted, or it is no longer shared with you.

desktop.label: The desktop of {title}

starting.title: Starting the desktop
starting.body: What you asked for is already waiting for the agent.

pausing.title: Pausing the desktop
pausing.body: The machine is being released. Its files are kept.

paused.title: The desktop is paused
paused.click: Its machine is released and its files are kept. Click here or send a message, and it resumes in about half a minute.
paused.message: Its machine is released and its files are kept. Send a message, and it resumes in about half a minute.
paused.none: Its machine is released and its files are kept. Someone who can write to its agent or use its desktop can resume it.

archiving.title: Archiving the desktop
archiving.body: It has been paused for a long time, so its disk is being saved and its machine deleted. Nothing is lost. You can bring it back in a minute.

archived.title: The desktop is archived
archived.click: It was paused for a long time, so its disk was saved and its machine deleted. Nothing is lost. Click here or send a message, and it comes back in about a minute.
archived.message: It was paused for a long time, so its disk was saved and its machine deleted. Nothing is lost. Send a message, and it comes back in about a minute.
archived.none: It was paused for a long time, so its disk was saved and its machine deleted. Nothing is lost. Someone who can write to its agent or use its desktop can bring it back.

desktop.lost: The connection to the desktop was lost. Reconnecting.

chat.label: Conversation with the agent
chat.empty: Tell the agent what to do. It works on the desktop beside this, where you can watch.
chat.waitingForDesktop: The agent will read this when the desktop is ready.
chat.agentStarting: The agent is starting. It reads what you asked for in a moment.
chat.desktopPausing: The desktop is being paused. The agent reads a message you send now when the desktop is resumed.
chat.desktopPaused: The desktop is paused. Send a message and it resumes; the agent reads it when it is up.
chat.desktopArchiving: The desktop is being archived. Send this in a minute, and it comes back.
chat.desktopArchived: The desktop is archived. Send a message and it comes back; the agent reads it when it is up.
chat.desktopFailed: The desktop did not start. Start it again and the agent reads this.

setup.failed: The setup script stopped with an error (exit {exit}).
setup.timedOut: The setup script did not finish in {limit} minutes and was stopped.
setup.after: The desktop is still there to use, and the agent knows the setup did not finish. Everything the script wrote is in ~/.workstream/setup.log on the desktop.
setup.output: The last lines the setup script wrote

newTask.title: New task
newTask.promptPlaceholder: Open our staging site, sign up as a new customer and tell me where the flow breaks.
newTask.environmentHint: What the desktop comes with. Change these under Environments.

createTeam.title: Create a team
createTeam.body: A team shares its tasks and environments. You can invite people after you create it.

noTeam.title: You're not on a team
noTeam.body: Create one to start a task, or open an invitation someone sent you.

share.title: Share {title}
share.body: Give someone outside the team this task alone: to watch it, to write to its agent too, or to use its desktop as well. They get nothing else of the team's.

roles.prompter: Watch and write to the agent
roles.driver: Watch, write and use the desktop

share.granted: {name} has the task now. Send them this link to open it.
share.grantedEmailed: {name} has the task now. We emailed them this link.
share.invited: {email} has no account yet. Send them this link: they create their account with that address and the task opens. It works once.
share.invitedEmailed: {email} has no account yet. We emailed them this link: they create their account with that address and the task opens. It works once.
share.watchOnly: This task is shared with you to watch. Ask whoever shared it if you need to write to the agent.

shareLink.unusable: It may have expired, been withdrawn, or been used already. Ask whoever shared the task to share it again.
